producerEligibleContext: current run factual SOURCE image attached directly
exact assigned P0 or P1 prompt
target aspect/raster already specified by the assigned prompt
explicitly authorized composition reference only in conditions that call for one
quarantinedContext: meta-analysis or meta-evaluation language as producer content
ad-hoc prompt changes derived from previous runs

checks: assigned prompt used without ad-hoc additions
prior generated outputs not intentionally exposed as references
no request to explain/score/audit/visualize the experiment reaches the producer

workingHypothesis: Intent routing is a material variable. Pre-generation meta-evaluation plus context quarantine may reduce leakage from discourse about the experiment into the requested product image.
